# Contractor Leads
> Contractor Leads (contractorleads.us) is B2B lead-finding software: marketing agencies, media buyers, suppliers and sales teams use it to find contractor leads (roofers, HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians and 14 more trades). It finds businesses from live Google Places data, adds owner names and verified emails, scores them Hot, Warm or Nurture, shows Meta ad status, and writes cold email, SMS and call scripts per lead. It does not sell homeowner leads to contractors.

Important facts:
- Audience: agencies and sales teams that sell to contractors. Not a service for homeowners hiring a contractor.
- Coverage: 18 home-service trades (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, solar, general contractors, remodeling, home improvement, flooring, landscaping, painting, concrete, windows and doors, fencing, garage doors, pest control, cleaning services, pool services) in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand.
- Data: live Google Places data at search time, cross-checked with Yelp and the business website. Unverified fields are left blank.
- Pricing: Free 10 leads with no card. Starter $19.99/month (500 credits), Growth $49/month (2,000 credits), Agency $99/month (5,000 credits), Enterprise custom. Annual billing lowers the monthly price.
- Integrations: GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, HubSpot, Slack, custom webhooks, CSV and Excel export. Email sends from the user's own Gmail, Outlook or SMTP mailbox.
- Company: Vaishali Media Productions LLC, Sheridan, Wyoming, USA. Contact: hello@contractorleads.us

- Full text of the guides, trade pages, tools and FAQ: https://www.contractorleads.us/llms-full.txt

## Free tools (no sign-up)

- [Contractor lead cost and ROI calculator](https://www.contractorleads.us/tools/contractor-lead-cost-calculator): cost per lead, cost per job won and return on spend
